body:
The standard `vm-qa` cloud-folder walks still assume CHANGE CLOUD FOLDER opens the saves keyboard directly. Current ES `1d76b3da7da75794066df1c089931b890304da7a` opens CLOUD FOLDERS first, with separate saves/settings/content rows (`GuiMenu.cpp` cloudOpenFolderSettings). The canonical menu/flow documents already describe this intermediate page. `tools/vm-walks/to-change-cloud-folder.steps` currently labels that intermediate-page capture `folder-editor`, and `confirm-cloud-folder.steps` then sends the old keyboard submission sequence. Actual replacement18 reproduction confirms the harness/reference mismatch: the old editor capture is CLOUD FOLDERS, START then closes to the carousel, and A opens the FBNeo game list. The old walk returned without a command error but failed its intended screen contract. No product navigation defect is claimed.

Found while preparing the final standard suites after #526. Archaeology checked the work-log/history and issue search; the only matching tracker was closed #78, about provider refusal rather than the current path-selection page. Completed #507 is not being repeated.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. The actual installed ES UI, synthetic local WebDAV, current path values and emitted reviewed frames supply the evidence. No personal device/cloud action is needed.

Already written: only test steps/reference expectations are stale. Existing player settings, selected paths and cloud payloads require no migration or repair. Keep original executed failures as failures.

Acceptance criteria:
- [x] Reproduce the old walk mismatch on the installed replacement18 image, retaining exact image/ES/source identity, original command/result and intended-versus-observed frame evidence.
- [x] Update the standard navigation composition and outcome assertions for the current independent path selector/editor/return behavior. Preserve selected-path and payload witnesses; retain a discriminating old-step control.
- [x] Review happy-path/branch frames at the relevant target sizes, update canonical flow/menu references and the accompanying screenshot index, and classify expected frame differences with bounded evidence rather than a blanket mask.
- [x] Run affected standard walks/frame comparisons successfully on the same immutable image using a separately frozen, published QA harness; retain all unaffected suite results with their original source. Update #508/M7, work/friction logs and checkpoint. No product rebuild is needed unless actual product bytes change.

Completed in order after replacement18 installed #526/CF10 and actual retained-storage upgrade proof; H700 → SM8550 is next. #519 remains before owner handheld deployment.


## Completion

Replacement18 final VM/local-protocol qualification is complete and published at `8b5113fa164ada7d002ab138b1e3a9bf795e9de5`; both exact-head hosted checks passed. Distribution `7f58b7b1c592908dcd0ba5987955e59aaa79fe66`, ES `1d76b3da7da75794066df1c089931b890304da7a`, immutable bundle `f557176651026f59bb5931993b12491a6019c0383321fb89fa1a05a596514fe6` remain unchanged. [Qualification](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/8b5113fa164ada7d002ab138b1e3a9bf795e9de5/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-pixelelated-replacement-18/qualification.md) explicitly combines 13 unaffected standard suites with the separately qualified #527 walk correction and the 78-frame comparison. The original qa-21 aggregate rc1 is preserved; it is not relabelled an all-green run. WebDAV, SFTP and S3 each pass 108 assertions (324 total). Clean installed CF10, public configuration preservation, #526's complete installed hook and the 31-check candidate16→18 update are accepted separately.

#527's published QA source `2e484871bd` and bounded frame claims `7233b237ee` pass at 640×480 and1280×800, with all16 new frames reviewed and exact config/path/local/cloud witnesses preserved. The corrected comparison has no unexplained or missing frames; the old wrong-screen control still fails. No baseline or blanket-mask change. Canonical menu/flow references and exact-source EN/FR branch evidence accompany the implementation. Prior source-overlay proofs remain labelled as such and their source inputs are mapped to the installed firmware.

#508 and #527 are complete; #507/#524/#526 remain complete and must not be rerun. All owned QA guests/providers and temporary payloads are stopped and retired after compact evidence retention. No compiler or audit is active at this reconciliation. Current work is #492: measure capacity, freeze matched H700 inputs and reuse only verified independent cache files; build/accept H700, then SM8550. Source/licence #344, branding #359, release/version/publication #265 and separately scoped physical gates remain. #519 precedes any owner handheld update transfer/reboot. No RC designation or personal-cloud/device mutation is implied.
